text: Novo Nordisk reported Wegovy pill sales exceeding estimates, with prescription volume concentrated in the new oral format. Guidance was revised upward within prior bounds. Market repricing followed disclosure. Competitive positioning persists against Eli Lilly across overlapping product classes.

text: Brent crude and WTI crude declined sharply as negotiation signals between United States and Iran emerged. Physical supply disruption at the Strait of Hormuz persists alongside provisional expectations of flow normalization; pricing adjusts under unresolved control conditions.
